title: 逆滲透膜組運轉~Reverse-osmosis membrane-train operation
focus: RO 回收率、鹽收支、驅動力與正規化診斷~RO recovery, salt balance, driving force and normalized diagnosis
summary: 本課以RO 回收率、鹽收支、驅動力與正規化診斷為主線，從進水分析與相容性、流股與回收率、截鹽率與濃度基準、濃水鹽質量閉合進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops ro recovery, salt balance, driving force and normalized diagnosis through ten connected units, beginning with feed analysis and compatibility, streams and recovery, rejection and concentration basis, concentrate salt balance. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 進水分析與相容性~Feed analysis and compatibility
units.mechanism: 先取得離子、鹼度、溫度、顆粒、有機物與氧化劑資料；電導率不能取代結垢離子分析。~Obtain ions, alkalinity, temperature, particles, organics and oxidant data; conductivity does not replace scaling-ion analysis.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=100 m³/h；溶解鹽=1000 mg/L。模型 Ms=QC/1000，代入得到 100 kg salts/h。適用邊界：同一離子或同一定義總鹽基準；電導率需水樣特定關係才能轉濃度。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=100 m³/h; dissolved salts=1000 mg/L. Model Ms=QC/1000 gives 100 kg salts/h. Applicability: Use the same ion or defined total-salt basis; conductivity requires a water-specific concentration relationship.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「進水分析與相容性」的觀測點。採進水、產水、濃水並記錄溫度及各離子分析。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for feed analysis and compatibility. Sample feed, permeate and concentrate with temperature and ion analyses. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只用總鹽度挑選所有前處理。診斷與介入：補做離子分析及流量配對，不將電導率無條件換成鹽質量。~Total salinity alone determines all pretreatment. Diagnostic response: Add ion analysis and matched flow, avoiding unconditional conductivity-to-salt conversion.
units.misconception: 相同電導率就代表相同結垢與污染風險。~Equal conductivity means equal scaling and fouling risk.
units.practice: 只改變 C:1000→1200 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 100 變為 120 kg salts/h。用「進水分析與相容性」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only C:1000→1200 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 100 to 120 kg salts/h. Explain the direction using feed analysis and compatibility, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 流股與回收率~Streams and recovery
units.mechanism: 辨識進水、產水與濃水，回收率描述分水比例；提高回收同時改變濃水與膜面條件。~Identify feed, permeate and concentrate; recovery describes water split, and increasing it changes concentrate and membrane-surface conditions.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Qfeed=100 m³/h；Qpermeate=75 m³/h。模型 Y=Qp/Qf，代入得到 0.75 fraction。適用邊界：水回收率，不是鹽截留率；高回收使濃水更濃。~Original teaching assumptions: Feed=100 m³/h; permeate=75 m³/h. Model Y=Qp/Qf gives 0.75 fraction. Applicability: Water recovery, not salt rejection; higher recovery concentrates the reject.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「流股與回收率」的觀測點。同步記錄進水、透過、濃水三支流量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for streams and recovery. Record feed, permeate and concentrate flow simultaneously. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 回收率被當作鹽去除率。診斷與介入：重新關閉三流股水量，檢查濃水條件與後段風險。~Recovery is mistaken for salt rejection. Diagnostic response: Reclose the three-stream water balance and check concentrate/downstream conditions.
units.misconception: 回收率越高就一定有更乾淨的產水。~Higher recovery always yields cleaner permeate.
units.practice: 只改變 Qp:75→80 m³/h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.75 變為 0.8 fraction。用「流股與回收率」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Qp:75→80 m³/h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.75 to 0.8 fraction. Explain the direction using streams and recovery, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 截鹽率與濃度基準~Rejection and concentration basis
units.mechanism: 用相同成分與分析基準比較產水和進水；單一進水基準的表觀截留不同於膜面本徵性質。~Compare permeate and feed on a common species/analytical basis; feed-based apparent rejection differs from intrinsic membrane behavior.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Cf=1000 mg/L；Cp=20 mg/L。模型 R=1-Cp/Cf，代入得到 0.98 fraction。適用邊界：同溶質、同基準；電導率近似不能替代所有污染物分析。~Original teaching assumptions: Cf=1000 mg/L; Cp=20 mg/L. Model R=1-Cp/Cf gives 0.98 fraction. Applicability: Same solute and basis; conductivity is not a substitute for every contaminant analysis.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「截鹽率與濃度基準」的觀測點。分析進水與透過水並保留溫度、採樣時間。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for rejection and concentration basis. Analyze feed/permeate and retain temperature and timing. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 以電導率比值當每個離子的精確截留率。診斷與介入：確認同成分及同溫基準，將鹽透過和水回收率分開。~Conductivity ratio is treated as exact rejection for every ion. Diagnostic response: Check same-species/temperature bases and separate salt passage from water recovery.
units.misconception: 高截鹽率保證所有微量物質都相同比例去除。~High salt rejection guarantees identical removal of all trace species.
units.practice: 只改變 Cp:20→30 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.98 變為 0.97 fraction。用「截鹽率與濃度基準」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Cp:20→30 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.98 to 0.97 fraction. Explain the direction using rejection and concentration basis, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 濃水鹽質量閉合~Concentrate salt balance
units.mechanism: 進水鹽量分至產水及濃水；在準穩態無沉澱假設下由收支算濃水，並列未量測損失。~Feed salt divides between permeate and concentrate; compute concentrate under quasi-steady no-precipitation assumptions and report unmeasured terms.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Qf=100、Qp=75 m³/h；Cf=1000、Cp=20 mg/L。模型 Cr=(QfCf-QpCp)/(Qf-Qp)，代入得到 3940 mg/L。適用邊界：穩態溶質收支、無結垢與吸附；濃差極化的膜面濃度仍更高。~Original teaching assumptions: Qf=100, Qp=75 m³/h; Cf=1000, Cp=20 mg/L. Model Cr=(QfCf-QpCp)/(Qf-Qp) gives 3940 mg/L. Applicability: Steady solute balance without scaling/adsorption; membrane-surface concentration polarization remains higher.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「濃水鹽質量閉合」的觀測點。比對三股流量與分析濃度，查收支殘差。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for concentrate salt balance. Compare all three flows/concentrations and inspect balance residual. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 直接把回收率倒數當實際濃水濃度。診斷與介入：將三流股流量與離子分析配對，列出沉澱或漏算流股。~Inverse recovery is used directly as concentrate concentration. Diagnostic response: Pair three-stream flows/ion analysis and list precipitation or omitted streams.
units.misconception: 鹽被膜阻擋就從系統消失。~Rejected salt disappears from the system.
units.practice: 只改變 Qp:75→80 m³/h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 3940 變為 4920 mg/L。用「濃水鹽質量閉合」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Qp:75→80 m³/h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 3940 to 4920 mg/L. Explain the direction using concentrate salt balance, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 滲透壓與淨驅動力~Osmotic pressure and net driving force
units.mechanism: 壓力差須扣掉滲透壓差才是近似淨驅動力；鹽濃度上升可降低產水而不一定是膜髒。~Subtract osmotic-pressure difference from hydraulic pressure difference for approximate net driving force; higher salinity can reduce output without fouling.
units.model: 原創教學假設：平均液壓差 ΔP=12 bar；滲透壓差 Δπ=4 bar。模型 NDP=ΔP-Δπ，代入得到 8 bar。適用邊界：忽略膜面濃差極化及沿程分布的概念淨驅動壓。~Original teaching assumptions: Mean hydraulic difference ΔP=12 bar; osmotic difference Δπ=4 bar. Model NDP=ΔP-Δπ gives 8 bar. Applicability: Conceptual net driving pressure excluding concentration polarization and axial distribution.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「滲透壓與淨驅動力」的觀測點。同時量鹽度、溫度與壓力，避免只靠加壓解釋產水。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for osmotic pressure and net driving force. Measure salinity, temperature and pressure rather than attributing production only to pressure. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 進水鹽度升高時只追查機械故障。診斷與介入：更新壓差和鹽度對應的滲透壓差，再分析通量變化。~Only mechanical faults are investigated when feed salinity rises. Diagnostic response: Update hydraulic/osmotic pressure differences before interpreting flux changes.
units.misconception: 提高水壓的每一 bar 都完全變成有效滲透驅動力。~Every additional bar of water pressure becomes effective osmotic driving force.
units.practice: 只改變 Δπ:4→6 bar，其餘假設固定；結果應由 8 變為 6 bar。用「滲透壓與淨驅動力」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Δπ:4→6 bar, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 8 to 6 bar. Explain the direction using osmotic pressure and net driving force, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 段間濃縮與結垢~Interstage concentration and scaling
units.mechanism: 後段離子濃縮與膜面濃差極化不同；結垢需用離子活度與飽和狀態評估。~Interstage concentration and membrane-surface polarization differ; assess scaling with ion activities and saturation conditions.
units.model: 原創教學假設：回收率 R=0.75；假設目標鹽完全截留。模型 CF=1/(1-R)，代入得到 4 ratio。適用邊界：無沉澱且完全截留的理想濃縮比；濃差極化使膜面濃度可能更高。~Original teaching assumptions: Recovery R=0.75; assume complete rejection of the target salt. Model CF=1/(1-R) gives 4 ratio. Applicability: Ideal concentration factor without precipitation and with complete rejection; concentration polarization can raise the membrane-surface value.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「段間濃縮與結垢」的觀測點。比較進水、濃水離子質量平衡與飽和指數，不只比電導率。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for interstage concentration and scaling. Compare feed/concentrate ion balances and saturation indices, not conductivity alone. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 以平均濃水濃度忽略局部膜面高濃度。診斷與介入：改用各離子質量與飽和分析，另估膜面濃差極化。~Average concentrate concentration hides higher membrane-surface values. Diagnostic response: Use ion balances/saturation analysis and separately estimate membrane-surface polarization.
units.misconception: 回收率相同就會有相同結垢風險。~Equal recovery gives equal scaling risk.
units.practice: 只改變 R:0.75→0.80，其餘假設固定；結果應由 4 變為 5 ratio。用「段間濃縮與結垢」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only R:0.75→0.80, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 4 to 5 ratio. Explain the direction using interstage concentration and scaling, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 壓力、功率與能源~Pressure, power and energy
units.mechanism: 輸送功率隨流量與壓差改變，完整能耗還須加前處理、附屬設備與能源回收的實測效果。~Pumping power varies with flow and pressure; total energy includes pretreatment, auxiliaries and measured recovery effects.
units.model: 原創教學假設：進水=100 m³/h；壓差=12 bar；泵效率=0.8。模型 P=QΔP/(36η)，代入得到 41.666667 kW。適用邊界：不可壓縮水及假想定效率；不含馬達損失、能源回收與附屬設備。~Original teaching assumptions: Feed=100 m³/h; pressure difference=12 bar; pump efficiency=0.8. Model P=QΔP/(36η) gives 41.666667 kW. Applicability: Incompressible water with assumed constant efficiency, excluding motor loss, energy recovery and auxiliaries.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「壓力、功率與能源」的觀測點。同步記錄流量、壓差與電功率，核對量測邊界。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for pressure, power and energy. Synchronize flow, pressure difference and electrical power and check measurement boundaries. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 用水力功率當全廠電表值。診斷與介入：以實測壓差、流量及電表核對效率，分列附屬與回收能源。~Hydraulic power is treated as plant electricity consumption. Diagnostic response: Check efficiency with measured pressure, flow and power, separating auxiliaries and recovered energy.
units.misconception: 單一高壓泵的效率就是整個水廠效率。~One high-pressure-pump efficiency is the whole-plant efficiency.
units.practice: 只改變 ΔP:12→14 bar，其餘假設固定；結果應由 41.666667 變為 48.611111 kW。用「壓力、功率與能源」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only ΔP:12→14 bar, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 41.666667 to 48.611111 kW. Explain the direction using pressure, power and energy, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 正規化趨勢與診斷~Normalized trends and diagnosis
units.mechanism: 把產水、鹽透過與壓差放回共同溫度、壓力與鹽度基準，才能比較污染與季節變化。~Normalize output, salt passage and differential pressure to common temperature, pressure and salinity bases before comparing fouling and seasonality.
units.model: 原創教學假設：實測通量=55 LMH；假想溫度修正乘數=1.10。模型 Jref=Jmeasured/TCF，代入得到 50 LMH。適用邊界：只是已知乘數的換算示例；實際修正需依膜型、壓力與鹽度共同正規化。~Original teaching assumptions: Measured flux=55 LMH; hypothetical temperature multiplier=1.10. Model Jref=Jmeasured/TCF gives 50 LMH. Applicability: Known-multiplier conversion only; real normalization depends on membrane type, pressure and salinity together.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「正規化趨勢與診斷」的觀測點。用同一膜型的核准正規化方法，保留原始溫壓與鹽度。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for normalized trends and diagnosis. Use the approved normalization method for that membrane type and retain raw temperature, pressure and salinity. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 直接比冬夏原始產水量判定老化。診斷與介入：依膜型核准方法完整正規化，保存原始溫度、壓力與鹽度。~Raw summer/winter output is compared to diagnose aging. Diagnostic response: Normalize fully using the membrane-approved method and retain raw temperature, pressure and salinity.
units.misconception: 溫度修正一個係數就能取代所有正規化步驟。~One temperature multiplier replaces all normalization.
units.practice: 只改變 TCF:1.10→1.05，其餘假設固定；結果應由 50 變為 52.380952 LMH。用「正規化趨勢與診斷」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only TCF:1.10→1.05, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 50 to 52.380952 LMH. Explain the direction using normalized trends and diagnosis, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 清洗恢復與完整性~Cleaning recovery and integrity
units.mechanism: 根據診斷與膜相容性採核准程序，之後同看正規化流量、鹽透過與壓差，避免只追高產水。~Use approved procedures based on diagnosis/compatibility, then examine normalized flow, salt passage and differential pressure rather than output alone.
units.model: 原創教學假設：新膜參考通透率=100；清洗後=90（同單位同溫度）。模型 RF=Lp_after/Lp_reference，代入得到 0.9 fraction。適用邊界：恢復率不證明膜完整或無化學損傷；須另做完整性／截留檢查。~Original teaching assumptions: Reference permeability=100; post-cleaning=90 at matching units/temperature. Model RF=Lp_after/Lp_reference gives 0.9 fraction. Applicability: Recovery does not prove integrity or absence of chemical damage; integrity/rejection checks are separate.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「清洗恢復與完整性」的觀測點。將恢復通量與截留、壓差一起比較。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for cleaning recovery and integrity. Compare recovered flux with rejection and pressure loss. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 清洗後產水增加但截鹽率變差仍宣稱成功。診斷與介入：把恢復通透率與截留或完整性證據一起判讀。~Higher output after cleaning is celebrated despite worse rejection. Diagnostic response: Interpret recovered permeability alongside rejection or integrity evidence.
units.misconception: 只要產水恢復就證明膜沒有化學損傷。~Recovered output proves absence of chemical damage.
units.practice: 只改變 Lp_after:90→80，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.9 變為 0.8 fraction。用「清洗恢復與完整性」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Lp_after:90→80, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.9 to 0.8 fraction. Explain the direction using cleaning recovery and integrity, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. units.title: 成品水、濃水與全鏈驗證~Product, concentrate and whole-chain verification
units.mechanism: 成品水依用途可能需後處理，濃水需合宜去向；RO 模組算式不能替代水質、許可與全廠驗證。~Product water may require post-treatment for its use and concentrate needs an appropriate destination; module calculations do not replace quality, permit or plant validation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Qf=100、Qp=75 m³/h；Cf=1000、Cp=20 mg/L。模型 Cr=(QfCf-QpCp)/(Qf-Qp)，代入得到 3940 mg/L。適用邊界：穩態溶質收支、無結垢與吸附；濃差極化的膜面濃度仍更高。~Original teaching assumptions: Qf=100, Qp=75 m³/h; Cf=1000, Cp=20 mg/L. Model Cr=(QfCf-QpCp)/(Qf-Qp) gives 3940 mg/L. Applicability: Steady solute balance without scaling/adsorption; membrane-surface concentration polarization remains higher.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「成品水、濃水與全鏈驗證」的觀測點。比對三股流量與分析濃度，查收支殘差。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for product, concentrate and whole-chain verification. Compare all three flows/concentrations and inspect balance residual. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只報回收率與電導率而漏掉穩定性及濃水管理。診斷與介入：將三流股流量與離子分析配對，列出沉澱或漏算流股。~Recovery and conductivity are reported while stability and concentrate management are omitted. Diagnostic response: Pair three-stream flows/ion analysis and list precipitation or omitted streams.
units.misconception: RO 產水低鹽就必定已適合任何用途。~Low-salt RO permeate is automatically suitable for every use.
units.practice: 只改變 Qp:75→80 m³/h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 3940 變為 4920 mg/L。用「成品水、濃水與全鏈驗證」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Qp:75→80 m³/h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 3940 to 4920 mg/L. Explain the direction using product, concentrate and whole-chain verification, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias.
